evidence.study_design: Sample size was small and the study was not randomised
evidence.relevance: Shade structures in school playgrounds and pupil heat exposure
evidence.outcome_touched: Playground temperature and pupil-reported heat discomfort
evidence.intervention_tested: Shade sails were installed at four primary schools
evidence.answers_question: Shaded schools recorded lower playground temperatures and fewer reported heat symptoms
evidence.sample_size: four primary schools and compared with four matched schools
